content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Beaumont

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Beaumont's energy and petrochemical sectors value this certification highly. Review PMI's specific thresholds, then contact Granite PM Academy to confirm your qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our Beaumont-focused sessions fit working professionals' schedules while delivering PMI's required contact hours in project management fundamentals, processes, and best practices aligned to real-world operations in your region.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, apply directly to PMI and pay the examination fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process. PMI will review your credentials and grant you authorization to sit for the PMP exam within a defined window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy offers exam-preparation support, including practice tests and strategy sessions, to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your exam at a Pearson Vue testing center in or near Beaumont. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy and PMI offer multiple pathways—continuing education, volunteering, and conference attendance—to meet your PDU target and demonstrate ongoing project-management expertise.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
